adaptations: Ratatui owns one mutable ReviewApp on the terminal thread; broker transport threads enqueue typed commands and wait for that owner to commit them.
Rust has no render-effect phase, so extension controls are installed synchronously before lifecycle events are queued to the replacement registry.
File-language registrations are session-local values in each provisional ExtensionPaneRuntime, eliminating the baseline global mutation while preserving the stable rollback behavior.
Native extension retirement is synchronous under one shared deadline. The event loop does not return or restore the terminal until retirement and already-started owner-thread writes have completed.
The Rust watcher has no Bun runtime and therefore implements the stable tree's removal of the Bun-version reload refusal by construction.
